0022600112.text: The Utah Jazz (1-1, 8th in the West, 4th in the Northwest and 1 game back) host the Los Angeles Lakers (2-0, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West, riding a two-game winning streak), with the Jazz at home 1-0 and coming off a win. Jusuf Nurkic is out for Utah with a foot strain, and Trey Alexander is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision. For Los Angeles, Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain) and Jake LaRavia (ankle sprain) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams have no games yet this season. Last season the Lakers beat the Jazz 4-0 in the series, most recently 131-107 on April 12, 2026 in Los Angeles.
